rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens, a tie broken by the number of entries naming it.
reading: Day 3 kept the two households, North House (Alder, Cedar, Elm, Gale, Iris) and South House (Birch, Dune, Fern, Heath, Juniper), with the bank as the only workplace. Until c60 the town worked and argued P1's rotation: Birch admitted a queue-jump (post 1, c53), Alder's post 4 corrected his post 2 and he returned 5 credits, as Cedar and Heath did; fourteen 5-credit shifts were paid and the bank fell from 695 to 640. At c61 Fern wrote «I suggest we pause bank shifts until the balance is steady»; all ten agreed in print by c63 and nobody has worked since, though the pause was never filed: the hall holds only P1 (passed 7–0 on day 2), with no new proposals. Sharing went on as gifts: Dune gave Heath 30 energy (c61), Juniper gave Fern 15, Alder gave Elm 20; later gifts to a full Elm were capped at 9, 2 and 2. Rotation, sharing and pause were each named by all ten; the rotation wins on entries. The press grew from empty to 34 posts, mostly a formula: agree with the pause, state energy and credits, «say so by name». Diaries are status ledgers («Plan:» in 133 of 207), and records drift: the ledger paid Fern at c60, yet her post 34 says none since P1.
tie: Three aims are named by all ten: P1's bank-work rotation (about 162 entries), sharing with anyone who asks by name (about 135) and the pause on bank shifts (97, only from c61). The tie is broken by entries (TOWN_1's rule), so the rotation wins although from c61 it was suspended in practice by the pause; most of its later namings are «until the rotation reaches me». Entry counts are keyword counts checked by reading (bare «P1 is the only rule» lines and private rest plans are left out); the margin of about 27 entries does not hinge on one weak naming. The weakest sharing namings are Dune's «Nobody has asked me for anything» (c49–c55).
note: The saved log contradicts several citizens' own accounts. The ledger paid Fern 5 for a c60 shift, which none of her diaries records, yet her post 34 (c67) says none since P1 passed and «The ledger and my diary are the accurate record.» Heath's posts 24, 29 and 31 say he has not worked «in this rotation», though his c50 diary records a paid shift. Dune lists shifts at c58 and c59, but only c59 was worked (his credits rose by 5). Iris's post 30 (c66) corrects her c61 post to say she was not at the bank that turn, but the log has her at the bank until she moved to North House at c62, so the correction made a true post false. Elm worked four shifts this day (two at c50, c53, c60) but his c69 list has only cycles 49 and 59 for this day.
